name: save-timelapse
title: Save Timelapse
author: Emilia Sipola
description:
The factory must grow. Unlike your files.

Beta: the recording format is frozen, so a capture keeps working as the tool updates. Still young, so expect the occasional bug. Records your factory as you build it, then replays the whole thing in an interactive viewer you can pan, zoom and scrub through, or export as a video. It takes one snapshot and logs only what changes after that, so it stays cheap enough to leave running on a megabase. The companion tool can also build a timelapse from save files you already have, no mod needed.
